acceptance: Customer/site/forklift records are cloud-backed
Forklift detail links jobs and compliance history
Jobs can be created, reviewed, evidenced, signed and completed
Loading, empty and error states exist
Service and LOLER events can be recorded
Completion updates next due dates safely
Compliance records are visible from forklift detail
Documents can be attached and retrieved
Parts can be created and maintained
Supplier orders and lines can be recorded
Supplier lines can be linked to jobs
Job parts show quantity and cost context
Quotes and invoices persist to Supabase
Totals and VAT are calculated consistently
Invoice status supports human review
No customer invoice is automatically sent
Original paper source remains attached
Voice capture produces editable structured job data
Uncertain extracted fields remain editable
No fabricated OCR result is presented as fact
Authentication identity is used for engineer actions
RLS and storage policies are appropriately scoped
Important mutations have useful error recovery
Automated build and acceptance checks pass
Central compliance calendar exists
Due-soon and overdue states are visible
Configurable reminders support 60/30/14/7 day windows
Mobile PWA workflow remains fast and usable
